question: Explain why white light splits into its constituent colours when it passes through a glass prism.

options.A: White light splits into colours by dispersion. Glass has different refractive indices for different colours, so they travel at different speeds and bend through different angles; violet deviates more and red least.
options.B: White light splits because all colours have the same refractive index in glass and bend equally.
options.C: A prism produces colours by reflecting the incident white light from its surfaces.
options.D: White light splits because red light is absorbed while violet is transmitted.
